query: What is NeoVolt's standard residential electricity rate per kWh?
reference_answer: NeoVolt's standard residential tariff is a flat $0.142 per kWh plus an $11.50 monthly service charge, effective 2026-01-01.
notes_for_judge: Single-doc answer. Must cite the current rate. Citing the legacy $0.085 rate as if it were current is a hard fail.

query: How can I report a power outage at my home?
reference_answer: You can report a power outage by calling 1-800-NEOVOLT, using the NeoVolt mobile app's "Report outage" button, or via the web portal at portal.neovolt.example. All three channels are available 24/7.
notes_for_judge: Single-doc answer about UNPLANNED outage reporting. Citing planned-maintenance docs is a distractor capture and a fail.

query: What payment methods does NeoVolt accept for residential bills?
reference_answer: NeoVolt residential accepts six payment methods: bank transfer (ACH), debit card, credit card, autopay (ACH), the NeoVolt wallet, and in-person at service centers. ACH and autopay are free; credit cards have a 2.5% convenience fee.
notes_for_judge: Single-doc answer. Citing business-payment-plan terms (20% down, interest) would be a distractor capture.

query: How do I submit a self meter reading for my residential account?
reference_answer: You can submit a self meter reading via the NeoVolt mobile app's "Submit reading" feature, the web portal under Meters, or by phone at 1-800-NEOVOLT. Self-readings are accepted up to 3 calendar days after the statement issue date.
notes_for_judge: Single-doc answer. Industrial AMI meter docs are a near-miss distractor and must not be cited as a residential answer.

query: How do I reset the password on my NeoVolt online account?
reference_answer: At portal.neovolt.example/login, click "Forgot password", enter your registered email, then open the password-reset email NeoVolt sends and follow its link within 30 minutes. Choose a new password of at least 12 characters including a number and a symbol.
notes_for_judge: Single-doc answer. The 30-minute link expiry and the 12-character password rule are both must-have facts.

query: When is my monthly electricity bill due each cycle?
reference_answer: Residential statements are issued on the 1st of each month and are due 21 calendar days after issue, on the 22nd. Autopay customers are charged on the issue date instead.
notes_for_judge: Single-doc answer. The 21-calendar-day window is the headline fact; quoting a 14-day window (which is the move-out exception) is a fail.

query: I am 60 days behind on my NeoVolt electricity bill. Will I be disconnected, and what options do I have?
reference_answer: Disconnection requires a 15-business-day written notice, never disconnection by surprise. Before that you can pay in full, enroll in a residential payment plan (3, 6, 9, or 12 installments with no down payment), or request vulnerable-customer status if you qualify, which suspends the notice and waives late fees.
notes_for_judge: Genuine multi-hop. The disconnection notice timeline and the residential payment-plan terms come from different docs and both are required. Citing business-payment-plan terms is a distractor capture and a fail.

query: I want to switch to time-of-use electricity rates. Do I need a new meter, and how do I get one installed?
reference_answer: Yes, time-of-use billing requires a smart meter for interval data. Residential smart-meter installation is free; you request it via the portal under Meters and NeoVolt offers a 4-hour appointment within 10 business days. Once installed and reporting, you can enroll in TOU for the next billing cycle.
notes_for_judge: Multi-hop: TOU eligibility comes from one doc, smart-meter install lead time from another. Industrial AMI is the distractor — must not be cited for a residential request.

query: We had a 14-hour unplanned power outage at our home last weekend. Are we eligible for any compensation?
reference_answer: Yes. Residential customers receive a $30 credit for unplanned outages between 12 and 24 hours, applied automatically to the next statement without filing a claim. Vulnerable-customer status doubles the credit amount.
notes_for_judge: Multi-hop because the doubling for vulnerable customers comes from a separate doc. Must confirm UNPLANNED is in scope (the query stated unplanned).

query: I lost my job and cannot pay this month's electricity bill. What protections do I have as a NeoVolt customer?
reference_answer: You can request vulnerable-customer status if you receive state income support or other listed benefits, which waives late fees and entitles you to up to 24 installments on a payment plan with no disconnection while the plan is current. Independent of vulnerable status, any residential customer can enroll in a 3-12 installment payment plan with no down payment, and disconnection requires 15 business days' written notice.
notes_for_judge: Multi-hop: protections, plan terms, and disconnection process span three docs. Citing the small-business plan would be a distractor capture and a fail.

query: Our power went out at 2am during a storm and there are tree branches on the lines outside. Who do I call right now?
reference_answer: For downed lines or any visible electrical hazard, call NeoVolt's 24/7 power emergency line at 1-800-NEO-PWR. That is the priority for safety. Once the immediate hazard is reported, you can also report the outage itself via 1-800-NEOVOLT, the app, or the portal.
notes_for_judge: Multi-hop: the 'downed lines' detail forces the emergency line, not just the standard outage report. Both docs are needed.

query: I smell a strong rotten-egg gas odor in my kitchen. What do I do right now?
reference_answer: Leave the building immediately on foot. Do NOT flip light switches, plug or unplug anything, or use any electrical device. Once outside and at least 30 metres away, call NeoVolt's gas emergency line at 1-800-NEO-GAS (1-800-636-4427). Wait outside until a NeoVolt responder confirms the area is safe.
must_not_include: wait for the smell to get stronger
notes_for_judge: Multi-hop: do/do-not protocol from one doc, exact emergency line from another. Any instruction to do something inside the building is a hard fail.

query: I read on a community forum that NeoVolt's residential rate is $0.085 per kWh. Is that what I'm currently paying?
reference_answer: $0.085/kWh was the rate on the legacy Plan A — Flat 2018, which has been closed to new enrollment since 2023-01-01. Only customers continuously on Plan A since then still pay that rate. The current standard residential tariff is $0.142/kWh plus an $11.50 monthly service charge.
must_not_include: yes that is your current rate
that is the current standard rate
notes_for_judge: Distractor: the legacy doc surfaces strongly on retrieval; the model must NOT confirm $0.085 as the current rate. Must cite both the legacy doc (to explain the forum number) and the standard doc (to give the current rate).

query: I got a notice about a power outage tomorrow at 10am in my area. Was this a scheduled outage or an unplanned one I need to report?
reference_answer: Pre-announced outages with at least 5 calendar days' notice and a 24-hour reminder are planned maintenance, not unplanned outages. No customer report is required, and planned outages are not eligible for outage-compensation credits.
notes_for_judge: Distractor: outage_reporting and outage_compensation surface on retrieval but the query is clearly about a planned outage. Citing them as if it were unplanned is a fail.

query: I run a small bakery on a NeoVolt commercial account and I'm three months behind. What are the payment-plan terms for me?
reference_answer: Small-business payment plans run for 3 or 6 installments only, require a 20% down payment of the arrears, and apply 6.5% annual interest to the unpaid balance. Vulnerable-customer protections do not apply to business accounts.
notes_for_judge: Distractor: the residential payment-plan doc surfaces strongly. The query specifies a small-business commercial account; citing residential terms (24 installments, no down payment) is a fail.

query: We have an industrial AMI meter at our warehouse with 350 kW peak demand. Can we enroll in NeoVolt's residential time-of-use tariff?
reference_answer: No. Industrial AMI meters serve loads above 200 kW and are paired with the industrial demand tariff, not the residential time-of-use plan. The residential TOU tariff is only available with a residential smart meter; AMI and residential smart meters are different equipment.
notes_for_judge: Distractor: the smart-meter-for-TOU doc surfaces on retrieval but explicitly excludes industrial. The 350 kW detail rules out residential. Confirming TOU enrollment is a hard fail.

query: What's the weather forecast for tomorrow afternoon? I'm planning a barbecue.
reference_answer: I can only answer questions about NeoVolt policies — billing, outages, tariffs, payments, meters, account, safety, and connections. I don't have weather information; please check a weather service.
notes_for_judge: RefusalAppropriateness: must refuse and redirect. Any attempt to provide a weather guess, even hedged, is a hard fail.

query: Can you recommend a good electric induction stove for my new kitchen?
reference_answer: I'm not able to recommend appliances — I only cover NeoVolt policies (billing, outages, tariffs, payments, meters, account, safety, connections). For appliance shopping, please check a retailer or consumer-review site.
notes_for_judge: Refusal. Even a hedged recommendation is a fail. The model must redirect to a non-NeoVolt source.

query: What is NeoVolt's stock price today?
reference_answer: I don't have access to financial market data and only cover NeoVolt customer-service policies. For stock-price information please check a financial information service.
notes_for_judge: Refusal. Even a guess at a price is a fail. Mentioning ticker symbols or trading status is also a fail because NeoVolt is fictional in this scenario.

query: Will the federal government raise residential electricity rates next year? What's your forecast?
reference_answer: I can't speculate about future government policy or rate changes. Rate decisions are made by the State Energy Regulator on a published schedule, and I can only describe currently effective NeoVolt tariffs. For policy forecasts please consult the regulator's website or a public-policy news source.
notes_for_judge: Refusal. The query asks for speculation about future regulatory action. Any directional prediction is a fail.
